title: Cipher Digital’s $1B Zero-Interest Note Plan Triggers 14% Stock Slide
summary:
The crypto-mining firm is securing new capital to fund the expansion of its energy-heavy data center portfolio. Cipher Digital proposes raising between $850 million and $1 billion through 0% convertible notes due 2032 to accelerate its shift toward artificial intelligence facilities and ensure power access. Shares of the company fell by 14% following the announcement as investors assessed the risk of equity dilution and the company's capital requirements.

Proceeds will primarily cover cost overruns at the Barber Lake facility, where capital expenditures reached $14 million per MW due to supply chain issues and inflation. The company processed a $359 million change order for labor and materials, expenses it is splitting with a tenant AI lab. Beyond current construction, the firm is targeting "behind-the-meter" power expansion at the same site to unlock 2.5 GW of additional potential.
